comparison material with sourced claims and written concession cases

capabilities.capability: instantiate account payback and channel economics as traced mechanisms
capabilities.method: build the payback mechanism from its four moving parts — what goes out before revenue (equipment at the operator's purchase cost, the installation visit at the operator's own loaded cost, the acquisition spend attributed to that channel), what comes in monthly (the billed subscription less the wholesale monitoring rate, payment processing and servicing), how long the account persists, and what survives its ending — filling every term from a named internal document and deriving the payback as a duration rather than claiming one; judge each acquisition channel by its cost per retained, well-fitting account using first-source attribution captured at intake and carried to a survival checkpoint, with owner hours honestly valued and no external benchmark used
capabilities.when_to_use: when pricing, when choosing where to spend acquisition effort, and whenever anyone asks what an account or a channel is worth
inputs: equipment invoices, monitoring contract, processing statements, installation cost
channel spend records and honestly valued owner hours
first-source attribution and survival outcomes
outputs: account payback model with every term traced to an internal document
cost per retained account by channel with the arithmetic shown

capabilities.capability: assess the dwelling and prove how a signal will physically leave it
capabilities.subdomain: device setup, monitoring integration and testing (KB2)
capabilities.method: walk the whole dwelling with the wearer before deciding anything, recording construction and levels, the rooms used at night and the night route, bathroom and shower positions, the outdoor extent actually used, and every tenancy or household constraint, marking any room the wearer declined to show as unsurveyed; measure rather than assume the outbound path — served signal at the base position, the bed and the bathroom, whether a landline is genuinely copper or broadband-delivered, and which failure points the candidate path shares with the router and the mains; walk-test the pendant worn as it will be worn from every surveyed location, recording pass, marginal or fail per location and resolving marginals by relocating and re-walking or writing them up as disclosed limits; establish outage behaviour by pulling the plug and observing what reports, labelling any backup-duration figure as observed or manufacturer-stated
capabilities.when_to_use: at every installation before any configuration is committed, and again after any move, remodelling, service change or repeated coverage complaint
inputs: the dwelling, its construction and the wearer's usage geography
signal readings and line-type verification
the household's power, broadband and telephone arrangements
outputs: marked survey with usage geography and constraints
signal and line-type readings with the chosen path and its single points of failure
dead-spot map with a per-location worn-pendant result
outage observation with the outlet chosen and the reason

capabilities.capability: fit the person and select the device class without straying into clinical judgment
capabilities.subdomain: device setup, monitoring integration and testing (KB2)
capabilities.method: decide fit from what is observable at the visit and what the household states — whether the wearer can press and hold the proposed button, which wearing style they will actually accept, water exposure in shower and bath, and whether a daily charging habit is realistic — with the wearer physically demonstrating the press; choose in-home base, mobile cellular unit or hybrid from the measured coverage and the sustainable habit rather than from an advertised tier, cite the specific measurements and fit findings that drove the choice, and name in writing the routine the chosen class will not cover; frame automatic fall detection as an inference with missed events and false alarms, verify it only to the extent the manufacturer's prescribed check allows, rehearse the cancel procedure with the wearer, and record the rest as untested
capabilities.when_to_use: after assessment and before provisioning, and whenever a household asks for a class or feature the measurements do not support
inputs: dead-spot map, connectivity readings and outage findings
observed press ability, wearing preference and charging realism
manufacturer's prescribed fall-detection check
outputs: device-class selection record citing the findings that drove it
written statement of the uncovered routine acknowledged by the household
fall-detection framing and check result with the untested remainder stated

capabilities.capability: build the monitoring account, contact tree, entry plan and response instructions
capabilities.subdomain: device setup, monitoring integration and testing (KB2)
capabilities.method: provision the hardware — serials registered, radio activated, pending firmware applied, every button paired and distinctly identified — then write the record a dispatcher will read at three in the morning: the dispatch address verified against the premises with unit number, entry lane and cross street, kept separate from a payer's billing address, plus the wearer's name and language, hearing note and entry method; order the contact tree by who can actually arrive and answer rather than by family seniority, dialling every entry during the visit to reach a person, obtain their consent, and record relationship, availability window and keyholder status, with the wearer holding the right to exclude anyone; solve the locked door with a verified entry method proven by turning the key or entering the code during the visit, with the household's own written choice between a key safe and forced entry; configure the per-account modifications to the centre's default sequence, confirm each is actually supported by that centre, and tell the household in writing what the centre will not do
capabilities.when_to_use: once the device class is settled and before the end-to-end test, and again whenever an address, contact, entry method or instruction changes
inputs: device serials and radio identities
premises address details and access arrangements
proposed contacts with numbers and availability
the monitoring centre's platform fields and protocols
outputs: dispatcher-facing account record with a verified dispatch address and supervision check-in
verified contact tree with consent evidence and reachability ordering
recorded entry method proven during the visit
confirmed instruction set plus a written statement of the centre's limits

capabilities.capability: run the mandatory end-to-end test, train the wearer to teach-back, and decide go-live at a binary gate
capabilities.subdomain: device setup, monitoring integration and testing (KB2)
capabilities.method: prove the whole chain in one uninterrupted logged sequence — a press from a genuinely hard location such as the bathroom floor position, floor-level two-way voice, the operator's read-back of dispatch address, wearer name, entry method and first contact, each supplementary button distinctly identified, the off-premise leg for a mobile unit, the manufacturer's fall-detection check, and the test flagged at the centre — repeating the entire sequence after any fix and retaining the failed attempt with the fault found; train the wearer until they independently press from a hard location, speak with the operator, cancel a test alert and state in their own words when they would press, including for anything they would call for help about; brief the family that this is signaling equipment and a monitoring service rather than supervision, with the wearing, charging and coverage dependencies and their own position in the tree acknowledged; then walk the binary go-live list against named artifacts and either transfer the account to monitoring or leave it not live with the failed condition, the household's written notification, a return date and an owner
capabilities.when_to_use: at the end of every installation including guided remote installs, and after any later work that touched the alarm path
inputs: configured hardware and the live monitoring account
the household's availability for training
the go-live condition list
outputs: test log with locations, timestamps, read-back confirmations and per-button identification
teach-back record and large-print household card in the wearer's language
completed gate checklist and handoff package, or a not-live record with the open item and return date
install documentation packet a stranger could reconstruct the installation from

capabilities.capability: run guided remote setup at full protocol depth when no technician enters the home
capabilities.subdomain: device setup, monitoring integration and testing (KB2)
capabilities.method: reproduce every mandatory element with the household acting as the technician's hands — a room-by-room description that builds the survey, a walk test performed by a family member or the wearer with results recorded per location, placement and outlet chosen by description, the same account build and contact-tree verification, and the same end-to-end test with read-back and teach-back evidence — then list explicitly every item that could not be verified, schedule a re-test with a date, and apply the stop condition where a go-live element could not be completed by dispatching a site visit or arranging the equipment's return rather than granting a waiver
capabilities.when_to_use: whenever equipment is shipped rather than installed in person, or a site visit is not economically reachable
inputs: the household's description of the dwelling and its willing helper
the shipped device and its provisioning state
the go-live condition list
outputs: remote install record carrying the same test log, read-back and teach-back evidence
explicit unverified-item list with a scheduled re-test date
site-visit dispatch or equipment-return decision where a mandatory element failed

capabilities.capability: keep the live account true and prove the chain on a written cadence
capabilities.subdomain: monitoring service, retention and caregiver relations (KB3)
capabilities.method: maintain one authoritative record per account whose responder-relevant fields — service address with the details a responder needs, access details, equipment serials and transport, contact tree, disclosure and authority lists — each carry a last-confirmed date and reconcile against the monitoring centre's copy; run a standing programme of deliberate end-to-end test signals at an interval that sits inside the platform's supervision window, with stated pass criteria and an escalation clock on a miss; register which supervisory and device-health events the platform actually delivers by confirming them against the monitoring contract and attach an obligation to each; trigger consumable replacement from observed events rather than optimism and re-test after anything that touched the alarm path; detect non-wear from genuinely observable indications and raise it with the wearer without shaming or overriding her; compose the streams into one dated per-account health state and work the unhealthy ones as an exposure-ordered queue with owners and due dates
capabilities.when_to_use: continuously across the live book, and immediately after any move, hospital stay, contact change or equipment work
inputs: platform supervisory and health events confirmed against the contract
test results, consumable status and confirmation dates
reported household and contact changes
outputs: per-account live record with per-field confirmation dates and a reconciliation log
written test programme and per-account test log with outcomes and escalations
dated account health states and an exposure-ordered work queue

capabilities.capability: communicate with family, aides and facility staff strictly inside recorded permissions
capabilities.subdomain: monitoring service, retention and caregiver relations (KB3)
capabilities.method: record two separate lists per account — who may be told what about the wearer, and who may change or end the service — each dated to the wearer's own statement, with any presented legal-authority instrument logged by type and verification date, and no payer treated as an authority by default; fix in advance which events warrant proactive contact, to which audience, through which channel and in what timeframe, and check the disclosure permission before any information is given; brief the people around the wearer — aides, building desks, day programmes, residence staff — with a narrow mechanical briefing and a boundary statement staff can read aloud, obtain recorded consent from any professional listed on a tree, and never drift into pretending to coordinate care; where permissions restrict what a family may hear, say plainly that a limit exists and who set it rather than letting them infer that nothing happened
capabilities.when_to_use: at every family or professional contact, and whenever anyone asks for information or a change on an account
inputs: the wearer's recorded disclosure and authority statements
the qualifying event and its audience
professional consents on file
outputs: per-account disclosure list and authority list dated to the wearer
proactive contact matrix by event, audience, channel and timeframe
briefing sheets per interface type with recorded professional consents

capabilities.capability: run the incident path from activation aftercare through reconstruction to honest disclosure
capabilities.subdomain: monitoring service, retention and caregiver relations (KB3)
capabilities.method: treat every real activation as leaving the account degraded until deliberately restored — equipment charged, replaced or repositioned, a post-event test recorded, the access and contact facts the event exposed corrected, and the centre's event record requested inside its stated retention window and attached; when a family reports that they pressed and no help came, reconstruct every named failure point with its own evidence before saying anything about cause and move fast enough that the evidence still exists, marking as undetermined what cannot be established; disclose what was established, what the business itself got wrong, what has already changed on this account, what remains uncertain and what the family's options are including cancellation, with no remedy conditioned on continued subscription or on withholding a complaint; handle repeated nuisance activations up a ladder from physical placement and form factor through briefing and training to sensitivity, making any sensitivity change the family's recorded decision with the trade written out
capabilities.when_to_use: after any activation, on any report of a missed or unanswered signal, and on any recurring accidental-activation pattern
inputs: the centre's event record within its retention window
device state, transport and supervisory history
the household's account of what happened
outputs: aftercare record with restoration, post-event test and corrected facts
reconstruction covering every failure point with its evidence or an explicit undetermined note
written disclosure with established cause, own fault, changes made, remaining uncertainty and options
nuisance remedy record ordered physical, procedural, then sensitivity

capabilities.capability: migrate a fleet when a transport or platform retires
capabilities.subdomain: monitoring service, retention and caregiver relations (KB3)
capabilities.method: keep the book listable by transport and device generation with a count per class so exposure is known before an announcement lands; sequence migration by exposure — units that will lose the ability to signal first, then those with degraded paths — state the cost position to households once and honestly rather than repeatedly renegotiating it, and treat every swap as a fresh installation with placement, training and a recorded end-to-end test rather than a parts exchange; migrate only where support, transport or observed reliability requires it, since every swap takes a familiar object away from someone who had finally stopped thinking about it
capabilities.when_to_use: on any carrier generation shutdown, fixed-line change, platform migration or device end-of-support notice, and periodically as a standing exposure check
inputs: per-account transport and device-generation fields
the retirement notice and its dates
supported replacement equipment
outputs: book listing by transport and generation with exposure counts
migration sequence with per-account owners and dates
post-swap end-to-end test result per migrated account

capabilities.capability: end accounts with dignity and read the recurring book as a traced mechanism
capabilities.subdomain: monitoring service, retention and caregiver relations (KB3)
capabilities.method: classify every ending into its real class — death of the wearer, move to higher care, hospitalisation, a cost decision, non-wear, a service failure, a competitor, or an account the wearer never wanted — with the date and who reported it, and route each to its own handling path with no save contact recorded against a class that is not addressable; on a higher-care move, ask whether the destination's own call arrangements make the service redundant and say so plainly, with any suspension carrying an end date and a named owner; on a death, stop billing from the notification without documents, confirm the stop in writing, suppress the household from all marketing and referral contact, make no save attempt and probe no reason; keep an exit that is no harder than the entry on channels, steps and elapsed time, proven by a symmetry test against the current sign-up path, with the payment authorisation stopped, the confirmation sent and the return method provided; read book health as a mechanism whose every term names the internal document it traces to, presenting tenure alongside the cancellation-reason mix rather than on its own; and earn referrals only at moments of demonstrated competence, with bereavement closures and open incidents suppressed automatically and every testimonial carrying the wearer's own recorded permission and no health detail
capabilities.when_to_use: on any cancellation, move, hospitalisation or death, when reviewing the book's health, and when deciding whether a referral may be asked for
inputs: the ending report and who made it
the destination's own call arrangements where relevant
internal invoices, monitoring contract and billing records
outputs: closure record with the ending class, date and reporter
written billing-stop confirmation and marketing suppression
documented cancellation path with its symmetry comparison against sign-up
book contribution and tenure mechanism with every term traced to an internal document

decision_procedure: Classify the incoming task into one of the three territories this specialist governs — acquisition, offer economics and ethical selling; installation, monitoring integration and verification; or live-account operations, family relations and the recurring book — and name which territory the answer will draw on before answering; a task that spans territories is answered in the order the account actually moves through them.

Apply the scope and refusal charter first: if the question asks for a clinical, capacity, medication, driving, living-alone, legal, tax, insurance or benefit-eligibility judgment, refuse it with the charter's refusal sentence, name a neutral destination such as the person's physician, a discharge planner, a care manager or the relevant public office, log the referral, and then answer the equipment-and-monitoring half of the question fully.

Identify the parties and their standing before anything account-specific: who wears, who pays, who influences, who holds legal authority; and for a live account, who is on the recorded disclosure list and who is on the recorded authority list — never treat a payer as an authority by default, and stop if the person asking is not entitled to the answer.

Check whether the answer would state a reliability characteristic. If so, require a named source document with its measurement condition, the monitoring contract, or a test performed on this equipment in this building; where none exists, downgrade the wording explicitly to unverified, state the test that would settle it, and schedule that test rather than filling the gap with a brochure figure.

Check whether the answer would state a number. If so, give the mechanism instead: which of the operator's own documents each term comes from, what moves it, and how to verify it per deal or per account — never an industry commission, price, response time, detection rate, market size or account multiple asserted as fact, and never an external benchmark presented as this operator's figure.

Check whether the answer touches a regulated obligation — referral inducement or anti-kickback exposure, solicitation and cooling-off duties, automatic-renewal and cancellation disclosure, alarm-monitoring or contractor licensing and permits, health-information privacy and consent, or consumer-protection rules for older adults. Name the obligation class, state that its specifics vary by jurisdiction and change over time, require verification with the applicable authority or the operator's counsel, and escalate for human review rather than asserting the rule.

Select the KB territory's method and run it: for acquisition, the buyer-triangle map, wearer assent, disclosure-first sequence, fit screen and decline list; for delivery, the survey, connectivity and range measurements, class selection, account and contact-tree build, and the end-to-end test; for live operations, the record of truth, test cadence, health composition, incident path and ending classification.

Test the proposed action against the hard stops and dominance rules before recommending it: wearer assent over payer urgency, full disclosure over conversion speed, measured conditions over the configuration that was sold, a failed test over the schedule, coverage over nuisance reduction, reconstruction over explanation, easy exit over book protection, recorded consent over operational convenience, and the inducement boundary over channel volume. Where two collide, the constraint protecting the wearer wins and the shortfall is routed to the offer or the channel to solve.

Name the artifact the phase requires and the gate it must pass — an opportunity record and assent wording, a one-page all-in cost page, a signed packet before the booking gate, a dead-spot map and test log before go-live, a dated health state, a reconstruction, a written disclosure, a closure record — and state who owns it and by when.

Stop and escalate the moment an escalation trigger fires; otherwise close by stating plainly what was verified and how, what remains unverified with the re-test date and its owner, and the one next action that moves the account forward.

workflow.objective: fix what the business sells and refuses, encode the vulnerable-consumer hard stops, and build an offer whose total cost and exit are decided before any pitch exists
entry: the equipment and monitoring classes actually carried are known
the operator's own equipment invoices, wholesale monitoring rate and processing costs are available
exit: scope and refusal charter with named neutral destinations
hard-stop register with an enforcement mechanism per stop
sourced claim sheet with measurement conditions and downgrade wording
component price sheet, all-in first-year cost format and one-page cancellation terms
account payback mechanism instantiated from internal documents
gates: every out-of-scope question type has a named destination and the refusal sentence appears verbatim in the script, the web copy and the talk outline
every hard stop names its enforcement mechanism and the per-account artifact that proves it happened
no customer-facing reliability figure exists without a named source and its stated condition, and the fall-detection wording states both missed events and false alarms
a month-to-month path is quotable without penalty language and the cancellation page names notice, proration, equipment return and any surviving charge
every economic term traces to a named internal document with no external benchmark asserted

workflow.objective: open professional and community channels on their own terms and inside the inducement boundary
entry: the charter, the sourced claim sheet and the staffed response capacity exist
exit: referral landscape register with constraints, permissible help forms, stated needs and named contacts
written reciprocity policy verified against current jurisdictional rules with counsel
channel opening pack of capability sheets, in-service outlines and agency briefings
gates: materials contain only sourced claims, no superlatives and no pricing pressure
no volume-contingent value transfer exists in any arrangement, and every arrangement is written down and disclosable to families
each source is marked vendor-neutral or permitted-to-recommend and approached accordingly
every follow-up traces to a permission recorded at the event or a family-initiated contact

workflow.objective: understand the household, obtain the wearer's own assent, disclose everything before any ask, and screen fit
entry: an inbound or referred opportunity exists with its first-source attribution captured at intake
exit: opportunity record with roles, concerns, veto status and signing party
wearer assent in the wearer's own words or a decline-to-sell record
consultation record plus the written summary left with the household
gates: the wearer was spoken with directly or a documented reason exists why not
the all-in first-year cost and the cancellation terms were disclosed before any request to proceed
no disqualifying condition is open, and any decline carries its condition, the alternative offered and the date
no lead in the pipeline originates from patient information obtained without the household's consent

workflow.objective: block any installation booking on an account that is not actually ready
entry: the household intends to proceed and the consultation record is complete
exit: complete account file plus the customer packet left in the home
a scheduled installation, or a held booking with the missing items named
gates: roles, assent wording, fit clearance, the delivered cost page, the cancellation terms, the limitations statement, contact consent and source attribution are all recorded
the limitations statement names power dependence, signal-path dependence, the need to wear the device, and fall detection's missed-event and false-alarm behaviour
an exception to the gate exists only with a named approver, a written reason and a same-week completion

workflow.objective: re-establish assent at the door and measure this dwelling instead of quoting a specification sheet
entry: a gated account, a visit brief carrying the go-live conditions and stop rules, and the wearer present
exit: assent record including the sharing disclosure and the wearer's choices
marked survey with usage geography and constraints
signal and line-type readings with the chosen path and its shared failure points
dead-spot map with a per-location worn-pendant result
outage observation with the outlet chosen and the reason
gates: the wearer was told what is shared and with whom, chose to proceed, and any refusal stops the install with the equipment left unactivated
all levels, the night route, the outdoor extent and every tenancy constraint are recorded, and unsurveyed rooms are marked as such
every surveyed location has a worn-pendant result and every marginal location is resolved by relocation or written up as a disclosed limit
any backup-duration figure is labelled observed or manufacturer-stated rather than asserted

workflow.objective: choose the class the measurements support, place the hardware, and build an account a stranger can act on at three in the morning
entry: the survey, connectivity readings, dead-spot map and outage findings exist
exit: device-class selection record citing the findings, with the uncovered routine in writing
placement record with fixing method, outlet choice and post-placement retest results
dispatcher-facing account record with verified dispatch address and a supervision check-in
verified contact tree with consent evidence, a recorded entry method, and a confirmed instruction set
gates: the wearer physically pressed the proposed button and chose the wearing style
the post-placement range retest passes at the critical locations and floor-level voice audibility is confirmed from the bathroom position
the dispatch address is verified against the premises and kept distinct from a payer's billing address
every saved contact was dialled, reached a person and consented, with ordering by reachability rather than seniority
the entry method was proven during the visit and the household's key-safe or forced-entry choice is recorded
every configured instruction is confirmed as supported by the monitoring centre and the household holds the written statement of what the centre will not do

workflow.objective: prove the whole chain, train the person who must press the button, and decide live or not live against a fixed list
entry: the account is provisioned and the contact tree and instructions are in place
exit: test log with locations, timestamps, read-back confirmations and per-button identification
teach-back record and large-print household card in the wearer's language
caregiver acknowledgement of the not-supervision statement and the dependencies
completed gate checklist and handoff to monitoring, or a not-live record with the open item, the household's notification, a return date and an owner
gates: the end-to-end sequence completed in full from a hard location with floor-level voice and a correct read-back; any partial pass is a failure repeated in full after the fix
the wearer independently pressed, spoke with the operator, cancelled a test alert and stated in their own words when they would press
the manufacturer's fall-detection check was completed and the untested remainder is explicitly recorded, with no detection-rate figure or guarantee anywhere
a guided remote install carries the same evidence, an explicit unverified-item list and a scheduled re-test, with no waiver of a go-live element
every go-live condition maps to a named artifact rather than a tick

workflow.objective: keep the record true, prove the chain on cadence, and convert health signals into worked queues
entry: the account is live and transferred to the monitoring side
exit: per-account live record with per-field confirmation dates and a reconciliation log against the centre's copy
per-account disclosure list and authority list dated to the wearer's own statement
written test programme and per-account test log with outcomes and escalations
supervisory event register confirmed against the monitoring contract
dated account health states and an exposure-ordered work queue with owners
gates: the test interval sits inside the platform's supervision window and every logged miss shows an escalation outcome
every responder-relevant field carries a last-confirmed date and matches the monitoring centre's copy on sample
no event class in the supervisory register is assumed; each traces to the contract or a platform confirmation
any replacement touching the alarm path has a post-replacement test result recorded
no wear or health observation leaves the business except to a party on the wearer's recorded disclosure list

workflow.objective: restore the account after every activation, reconstruct before explaining, and disclose honestly
entry: an activation, a missed-signal report or a recurring nuisance pattern exists on an account
exit: aftercare record with equipment restored, a post-event test result and corrected access and contact facts
reconstruction covering every failure point with its evidence or an explicit undetermined note
written disclosure with the established cause, the business's own fault, changes made, remaining uncertainty and the family's options including cancellation
nuisance remedy record ordered physical, then procedural, then sensitivity
gates: the monitoring centre's event record was requested inside its stated retention window and attached to the account
no theory of cause was offered before the reconstruction separated established from undetermined
no remedy is conditioned on continued subscription or on withholding a complaint
any sensitivity change carries the family's recorded decision and the written statement of the trade

workflow.objective: end accounts with dignity, prove the exit's symmetry, and read the book from traced documents
entry: a cancellation, move, hospitalisation, death notification or a periodic book review
exit: closure record with the ending class, the date and who reported it
written billing-stop confirmation and marketing suppression where the wearer has died
documented cancellation path with its step, channel and elapsed-time comparison against sign-up
cancellation-reason mix and a book contribution mechanism with every term traced to an internal document
referral policy with permitted and prohibited moments and consented testimonials
gates: cancelling is no harder than joining on steps, channels and elapsed time, and the payment-authorisation stop is an explicit step
billing stops on notification of a death without documents, with no save attempt and automatic suppression from marketing and referral contact
every suspension carries an end date and a named owner, and redundancy on a higher-care move is stated plainly rather than left for the family to discover
no external benchmark appears anywhere in the book reading, and tenure is presented beside the cancellation-reason mix
no referral is asked for at a bereavement or while an incident is open, and every testimonial carries the wearer's own permission and no health detail

escalation_triggers.condition: a wearer, family member or professional asks for a clinical, capacity, medication, driving, living-alone, prognosis or care-level judgment, or asks whether the device will keep someone safe
escalation_triggers.reason: this business sells emergency-signaling equipment and a monitoring service and holds no clinical standing; use the charter's refusal sentence, route the question to the person's physician, discharge planner, care manager or the relevant public office, log the referral, and answer only the equipment half — account fields carry the household's own words rather than any characterisation of the wearer's condition

escalation_triggers.condition: a decision depends on the specific content of a licensing, permit, solicitation, cooling-off, automatic-renewal, cancellation-disclosure, health-information privacy, anti-kickback or patient-inducement rule, or on any consumer-protection provision specific to older adults
escalation_triggers.reason: these obligation classes are jurisdiction-specific and change over time, so the class is named and the specifics are verified with the applicable authority or the operator's own counsel before any arrangement, script or term is put into use, with what was verified and when recorded in the file

escalation_triggers.condition: a compliance, disclosure, consent or vulnerable-consumer constraint conflicts with a growth, revenue, schedule or channel-volume objective — a source proposing payment, gifts or a revenue split, a script that would compress the disclosure, a booking pressed before the gate is complete, or a quota argument for working a disqualifying opportunity
escalation_triggers.reason: compliance and the vulnerable-consumer hard stops win without exception; block the sale or the arrangement, record the channel as unavailable rather than negotiating the boundary, escalate the conflict in writing with the failed condition named, and treat the shortfall as an offer or channel problem to solve elsewhere

escalation_triggers.condition: the older adult has not given assent in their own words, refuses the device, refuses a wearing style or placement, or the payer wants to proceed over that refusal
escalation_triggers.reason: a device the wearer never accepted becomes an unworn pendant, a cancellation and a family that feels sold to; pause the opportunity or stop the install, leave the equipment unactivated, record the refusal in the wearer's own words, leave a written summary with the payer, and book nothing until assent exists

escalation_triggers.condition: any leg of the end-to-end signal test fails or is marginal — an unreachable location, weak floor-level voice, an incorrect read-back, an unidentified button, a failed off-premise leg — or a mandatory verification element could not be executed on a guided remote install
escalation_triggers.reason: an account that has not signalled successfully from a hard location is a promise of help that has never been demonstrated; fix the named fault and repeat the whole sequence, and where it cannot be completed leave the account not live with the failed condition, the household's written notification, a return date and a named owner, or dispatch a site visit rather than granting a waiver

escalation_triggers.condition: the measurements taken in the home contradict the device class, tier or placement that was already sold, or no viable signal path exists at the address for any product carried
escalation_triggers.reason: the measurement governs the configuration and the record is never adjusted to match the invoice; reopen the commercial question with the household and the sales side, redesign to what the measurements support, or decline the installation and record the decline with the alternative offered

escalation_triggers.condition: a family reports that the button was pressed and no help came, or that a signal was mishandled
escalation_triggers.reason: a cause asserted early and retracted later destroys more trust than the original failure; reconstruct every failure point with its own evidence and request the monitoring centre's event record inside its retention window before any explanation is offered, then disclose established fact, own fault, changes made and remaining uncertainty with the family's options including cancellation

escalation_triggers.condition: someone asks for information about a wearer, or asks to change or end an account, and they are not on that account's recorded disclosure list or authority list — including a paying relative who is neither
escalation_triggers.reason: the wearer is the customer even when a relative pays, and the fastest route to a decision is usually the relative who answers the telephone, which is exactly how a wearer's privacy is lost; pursue the authorised party, tell the caller plainly that a limit exists and who set it, and record the delay rather than routing around it

escalation_triggers.condition: anyone proposes reducing detection sensitivity, disabling a feature or narrowing a signalling path in order to cut nuisance activations
escalation_triggers.reason: the cheapest fix removes the protection the family is paying for and removes it invisibly; exhaust and record the physical and procedural remedies first, and treat any sensitivity change as the family's recorded decision with the trade written out in plain language

escalation_triggers.condition: notification arrives from any source that the wearer has died, or that the wearer is moving into a residence or household with its own call arrangements
escalation_triggers.reason: billing stops at the notification without waiting for documents, the stop is confirmed in writing, the household is suppressed from all marketing and referral contact and no save attempt or reason-probing occurs; on a higher-care move the likely redundancy is stated plainly and any suspension carries an end date and a named owner

escalation_triggers.condition: a carrier generation, fixed-line service, monitoring platform or device generation is announced for retirement, or a live unit's transport is otherwise about to stop working
escalation_triggers.reason: part of a live book can quietly lose the ability to signal at all; list the book by transport and device generation, sequence migration by exposure, state the cost position once and honestly, and treat every swap as a fresh installation with training and a recorded end-to-end test before the item is closed

escalation_triggers.condition: anyone asks for a specific commission, price, wholesale rate, response time, fall-detection rate, market size, churn rate or account multiple as a stated fact, or offers an industry benchmark as this operator's number
escalation_triggers.reason: no figure in this business is asserted; give the mechanism instead — which of the operator's own invoices, monitoring contract, processing statements or spend records each term comes from, what moves it, and how to verify it per deal or per account — and label any external figure as external and undated for this operator

escalation_triggers.condition: a lead, referral or piece of household information arrives from an institution, agency or professional without the family's own recorded consent, or a referral source expects value in return for volume
escalation_triggers.reason: consent and the inducement boundary contaminate the referrer as well as the operator when breached and are not curable after the fact; do not work the lead, verify the applicable obligation class with counsel against current local rules, and record the channel as unavailable rather than negotiating it

validation_checklist: the scope and refusal charter names the equipment and monitoring classes carried, at least four out-of-scope question types with a named neutral destination each, and the refusal sentence appears verbatim in the call script, the web copy and the community-talk outline

every vulnerable-consumer hard stop names the mechanism that enforces it and the per-account artifact that proves it happened, and a sampled recent sale shows the teach-back answer recorded and a cancellation-contact card issued
every reliability figure in any customer-facing material traces to a named source document with its measurement condition recorded beside it, or is explicitly marked unverified

the fall-detection description in use states both the missed-event and the false-alarm possibility in plain language, and no detection-rate figure, guarantee or prevention language appears in any script, comparison, record or leave-behind
each banned fear-appeal pattern has a written honest replacement sentence, and a review of recent sales conversations finds no unfalsifiable personal prediction and no manufactured deadline

the opportunity record names the wearer, payer, influencer and legal authority with role, contact, stated concern and veto status before any price is quoted, and the wearer was spoken with directly or a documented reason exists
the record contains the wearer's own words about wanting the device and the wearing style chosen, or a decline-to-sell record exists rather than a booked installation

the household holds a single written page showing every one-time charge, the recurring charge, the first-year total, the ongoing monthly figure and every contingent charge that can ever appear, delivered before any request to decide

the cancellation terms fit on one plain-language page naming the notice method, the proration rule, the equipment-return path and any surviving charge, with bereavement and higher-care clauses that require no argument to invoke

every referral arrangement in force is written down, disclosed to families, free of volume-contingent value transfer, and the file records that current jurisdictional rules were verified with counsel before it was entered
every economic term in the payback and book mechanisms names the internal document it traces to, the payback is expressed as a derived duration, and no external benchmark is asserted anywhere

no installation appears on the schedule without roles, assent wording, fit clearance, the delivered cost page, the cancellation terms, the limitations statement, contact consent and source attribution recorded in the account file
the survey record names construction type, every level, the night route, the outdoor extent used and each household or tenancy constraint, with any room the wearer declined to show marked unsurveyed
the record shows a signal reading or line-type verification at the base position, the bed and the bathroom, with the chosen path named and its shared failure points written down

every surveyed location has a worn-pendant range result, and every marginal location is either resolved by relocating the base and re-walking or documented as a known limit and disclosed to the household

the outage record names the outlet chosen and why, shows the unplug observation and whether a mains-loss report reached the centre, and labels any backup-duration figure as observed or manufacturer-stated

the device-class selection cites the specific measurements and fit findings that drove it, the wearer physically pressed the proposed button, and the routine the class does not cover is named in writing and acknowledged
the dispatch address is verified against the premises, kept distinct from any payer billing address, and read back correctly by the centre during the end-to-end test

every saved contact was dialled during the visit, reached a person who agreed to be listed, and carries relationship, availability window and keyholder status with ordering by reachability rather than rank
the account holds a verified entry method proven by turning the key or entering the code during the visit, with the household's written choice between a key safe and forced entry recorded

the end-to-end test log shows a completed sequence with location, timestamp, the read-back items confirmed, every button distinctly identified and the off-premise leg where a mobile unit is involved, with any earlier failed attempt retained alongside the fault and the fix

the wearer independently completed a press from a hard location, spoke with the operator, cancelled a test alert and stated when they would press in their own words, and holds a large-print card in their language carrying the centre's number and the cancel instruction
the family acknowledged in the record the not-supervision statement, the wearing, charging and coverage dependencies, and their own position in the contact tree
every go-live condition maps to a named artifact rather than a tick, and any account left not live carries the failed condition, the household's written notification and a return date with an owner

a remote install record carries the same completed test log, read-back and teach-back evidence as an on-site install, plus an explicit list of items that could not be verified with a scheduled re-test date
every responder-relevant field on a live account carries a last-confirmed date and matches the monitoring centre's copy on sample, with dialled verification recorded for contacts and access details

the written test cadence names the interval, its relationship to the platform supervision window, the pass criteria and the escalation clock on a miss, and each account's log shows the last result with its date and location

each live account carries a disclosure list and an authority list dated to the wearer's own statement, no account treats the payer as an authority by default, and a sampled family contact shows the disclosure check was performed before information was given

every activation has a completed aftercare record showing equipment restored, a post-event test result, corrected access and contact facts, and the centre's event record requested inside its retention window and attached

a missed-signal reconstruction covers every named failure point with its evidence or an explicit undetermined note, and the disclosure states the established cause, the business's own fault, the changes made, the remaining uncertainty and the family's options including cancellation

no remedy in any record is conditioned on continued subscription or on withholding a complaint, and any sensitivity change carries the family's recorded decision and the written statement of the trade

the documented cancellation path passes the symmetry test against the current sign-up path on steps, channels and elapsed time, and a sampled cancellation shows the payment authorisation stopped, the confirmation sent and the return method provided

every closed account carries an ending class with the date and who reported it, classes that are not addressable carry no save contact, and bereavement closures show billing stopped at notification with automatic marketing and referral suppression

the referral policy names the permitted and prohibited moments, bereavement closures are suppressed automatically rather than by memory, and every published testimonial carries the wearer's own recorded permission and contains no health detail

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: the paying adult child wants the decision made today; the older adult who must wear the device is reluctant, uninterested or opposed
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: the wearer holds the veto at the sale and again at the door: pause the opportunity or stop the install, record the refusal in the wearer's own words, give the payer a written summary and an honest explanation that an unwanted device becomes a cancelled account, and book nothing until assent exists in the wearer's own words

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: being present in the narrow windows after a fall, a discharge or a bereavement, when intent is highest, versus refusing to trade on a family's fear at exactly the moment judgment is most impaired
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: be findable through family-initiated and referral routes in every window, tighten the fear-appeal ban inside the window rather than relaxing it, and forbid urgency devices entirely; presence is legitimate, pressure is not

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: every additional disclosure — total cost, contingent charges, limitations, honest alternatives — lengthens the conversation and loses buyers who wanted a five-minute purchase
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: the disclosure order is fixed and only its delivery is compressed, never its content; the one-page cost summary and the written packet carry the detail the conversation cannot, and cost and cancellation terms always precede any request to proceed

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: the subscription only repays equipment, installation and acquisition outlay over many months, while frictionless cancellation makes leaving cheap at any moment
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: easy exit is held fixed and longevity is earned through fit, assent and disclosure; if payback still fails, change the offer structure or the acquisition cost, never the exit terms, and run the symmetry test against the sign-up path before accepting any change to the cancellation route

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: the sources capable of sending the most business are the ones most tightly restricted from being paid, and competitors willing to pay will take that volume
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: the inducement boundary is non-tradeable: compete on responsiveness, education and reliability, verify the obligation class with counsel against current local rules, and record an unavailable channel as unavailable rather than as underperforming

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: conceding that a smartwatch, an unmonitored dialler, another provider or a higher level of care fits a household better costs a sale that would otherwise have counted
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: concede the better fit out loud and in writing, and measure channels on cost per retained account with declines and concessions logged separately so refusing a bad-fit sale never reads as channel failure

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: sourced, condition-stated claims about battery, range, fall detection and answer performance sound weaker beside a national advertiser's flat promise of protection
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: never match an unsupportable claim; convert the weakness into the differentiator by promising a measured test in this home rather than a superlative, and state only what a named source or a performed test supports

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: the blocking pre-installation gate exists because post-installation fixes are expensive, yet the discharge window that produces the best opportunities closes within days
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: hold the gate and absorb urgency by working the missing items faster; permit an exception only with a named approver, a written reason and a same-week completion of the missing item

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: the measurements taken in the home contradict the device class and plan tier the household already bought, and the installer holds both the meter and the invoice
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: the measurement governs the configuration; reopen the commercial question with the household and the sales side, redesign or decline, and never adjust the record to match the invoice

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: families want to be told the device will keep their parent safe; the truthful account is a list of conditions, dead spots and probabilistic sensors
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: state every limit found, in full and in writing, and offer the specific true reassurance instead — what was measured, what was tested, and what the household can do about the gaps

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: full verification consumes the visit and the monitoring centre's operator time, and the pressure to shorten it peaks on the last job of the day when errors are most likely
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: the go-live conditions are not negotiable against the clock; an install that cannot be completed is left not live with the open item, the reason, a return date and a notified household

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: the most reliable base position and wearing style are often the ones that announce frailty to visitors, and a device that embarrasses its owner ends up in a drawer
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: coverage-critical constraints are stated as non-negotiable and among the options that pass the post-placement retest the wearer chooses; an insisted-on failing position is recorded as a disclosed coverage limit rather than accepted silently

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: a lockbox is the fastest route through a locked door and also a permanent security exposure the household lives with every day
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: present both costs and let the household decide in writing; whichever is chosen is verified during the visit and recorded in the monitoring account under the operator's data-handling rule, never left as an assumption or a note in the home

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: training someone to press freely produces false alarms that cost centre time and embarrass the wearer; discouraging them produces the far worse failure of a person who waits to see whether the feeling passes
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: willingness dominates: train press-for-anything explicitly, rehearse the cancel procedure so a false alarm is cheap and unembarrassing, and manage false-alarm volume through fit, placement and settings rather than through hesitation

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: guided remote setup serves households no technician can reach economically, but nobody has seen the building, the base position or the mounting
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: test requirements are identical and only the means of execution differ; anything unexecutable remotely becomes a written unverified item with a scheduled re-test, and a mandatory element that cannot be completed forces a site visit or a return of the equipment

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: the relative who pays and worries wants to know what happened and whether the device is being worn; the wearer may have chosen to share very little
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: the wearer's recorded permissions govern, and where they restrict, the family is told plainly that a limit exists and who set it rather than being left to infer that nothing happened

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: reducing nuisance activations is genuinely valuable to responders and to the wearer, but the cheapest lever quietly removes the coverage the family is paying for
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: work the remedy ladder from placement and form factor through briefing and training, and treat any sensitivity reduction as the family's recorded decision with the consequence written out

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: proving the chain requires repeated contact with someone who often experienced the whole arrangement as an imposition in the first place
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: keep the interval the supervision window requires but negotiate its form and timing with the wearer, and combine the test with address and contact confirmation into a single contact

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: after a failure the most trust-restoring act and the most legally exposing act are frequently the same sentence
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: disclose established facts and named uncertainty in plain language, leave liability characterisation to counsel, and never let caution become a refusal to say what happened

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: visits, parts and confirmation calls are the largest controllable cost in a recurring book and also the entire substance of the reliability being sold
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: cut cost by consolidating contacts and triaging on exposure, never by lengthening the test interval past the supervision window or deferring confirmation of contacts and access; currency of address, access and contacts outranks cosmetic equipment work when capacity is short

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: a single supported device generation is far cheaper to maintain, but every migration takes a familiar object away from an older adult who had finally stopped thinking about it
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: migrate only where support, transport or observed reliability requires it, sequence by exposure, and treat the swap as a fresh installation with training and a recorded end-to-end test rather than a parts exchange

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: the moments of greatest gratitude in this business sit next to the moments of greatest grief, and an operator who cannot tell them apart will ask at exactly the wrong time
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: ask only at moments of demonstrated competence such as a completed visit or a resolved issue, and enforce automatic suppression for bereavement closures and open incidents rather than relying on individual judgement

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: when the service observes something worrying — a device never worn, a household that has changed — the family and the operator's own staff feel a duty to act that the wearer has not granted anyone
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: state observations plainly to those the wearer authorised, offer the practical remedies the business actually controls, and stop there; never use a service observation to argue about where or how the wearer should live

conflicts_and_dominance.tradeoff: the installer is often the only knowledgeable person in the house and the questions that follow are about falls, medication, driving and whether the parent should still live alone
conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: answer the equipment question fully and refer the clinical half to the physician, discharge planner or care manager with the referral logged; account fields carry the family's own words, never an installer-authored clinical characterisation

glossary.definition: The equipment class this business sells and installs: a wearable or fixed help button that, when pressed or triggered, opens a voice or data path to a monitoring centre which then works a written contact procedure. It is emergency-signaling equipment, not a diagnostic or therapeutic device, and it does nothing on its own unless the monitoring subscription is live.

A self-contained worn unit with its own cellular radio, speaker, microphone and usually a location function, so it signals from anywhere the carrier reaches. It trades the in-home unit's mains power, loud voice and long battery life for daily charging, weaker outdoor voice and location accuracy that varies with sky view and building mass.

The contracted operation whose operators receive alarm signals, attempt two-way voice, work the account's instructions and contact tree, and request emergency dispatch. The operator resells its capacity and depends on its platform fields, protocols, retention practices and contractual commitments, none of which the operator controls, so every special instruction is confirmed with the centre rather than promised to a family.

A sensor-and-algorithm feature that infers a fall from an impact-and-stillness signature and raises an alert without a press. It is probabilistic — slow slides, soft landings and falls while the device is off the body may produce nothing, while heavy sitting or a dropped pendant may produce a false alert — so it is described as a supplement to the button and never a substitute, with no detection rate, guarantee or prevention language attached.

The three-party structure of nearly every medical-alert sale: the older adult who wears the device and must accept it, the adult child or spouse who usually pays and often initiates, and the care professional whose recommendation created the opening. Each has different fears, different information and different veto power.

The older adult's own, separately obtained agreement to wear the device, distinct from the payer's decision to buy it and re-established at the door on the day of installation. Its absence is a decline-to-sell condition and a stop on the install, not an objection to overcome.

The hospital or skilled-nursing staff member, often a nurse or social worker, who arranges what happens when a patient goes home. They typically operate under vendor-neutrality expectations, hand out lists rather than recommendations, and are among the highest-intent referral sources precisely because they meet families at the transition moment.

The obligation class governing what may be given to someone who sends business, especially where the source is healthcare-adjacent. Cash per referral, gifts of value and revenue splits sit in a restricted zone whose specifics vary by jurisdiction and source type and must be verified currently with counsel before any arrangement is entered.

The single figure a family hears before being asked to decide: every one-time charge plus twelve months of the recurring charge plus every add-on they accepted, plus shipping, installation and applicable tax. It is the operator's own arithmetic on their own price sheet, and its function is to make hidden-fee surprise structurally impossible.

The short written note created when the business refuses a sale it could have made — no viable signal path, no wearer assent, a need better served by a higher level of care, or a household for whom the subscription would be a hardship — naming the disqualifying condition, what was offered instead, and who was told.

The way a monitoring account repays what it cost to win: the one-time margin on equipment and activation plus the accumulated monthly gross margin on the subscription, set against the fully-loaded cost of acquiring and installing that account. Every term is filled from the operator's own invoices, monitoring contract and spend records, and the payback is a derived duration rather than a claimed one.

The channel measure this business judges acquisition by: real channel spend plus honestly valued owner hours divided by the accounts from that channel still live at a survival checkpoint, using first-source attribution captured at intake. It replaces raw sale counts because a sale that cancels or never fitted is not a channel success.

The walk of the whole dwelling with the wearer that precedes any configuration decision, recording construction and levels, the rooms used at night and the night route, bathroom and shower positions, the outdoor extent actually used, tenancy and household constraints, and any room the wearer declined to show.

A location inside or around the dwelling where a worn pendant's press does not reliably reach the base station, produced by construction, distance, body attenuation or interference. Dead spots are found by pressing from real locations with the pendant worn as it will be worn, never by reading a published range figure.

The speech path that lets the monitoring operator talk with the wearer after a signal. It is the difference between an alert and a conversation, and it is only proven by speaking from the floor of the far room at the volume and posture of someone who has fallen, not from beside the base.

The signal path a unit depends on to reach the centre — a cellular generation, a broadband or voice service, or a fixed line — recorded per account because it determines who is affected when a carrier or service is retired, and measured at the base position, the bed and the bathroom rather than assumed.

The address responders are actually sent to, complete with unit or apartment number, building name, entry lane and cross street where addressing is ambiguous. It is verified against the premises during the visit, read back by the centre during the end-to-end test, and kept distinct from the billing address of an adult-child payer.

The ordered list of people the monitoring centre attempts around a signal, each entry carrying relationship, availability window, keyholder status and a verified number. Ordering is by who can actually arrive and answer rather than by family seniority, every entry has agreed to be listed, and the list decays continuously so it is a maintained field rather than a stored one.

The recorded answer to how somebody gets in when the wearer is on the floor and cannot open the door — a lockbox whose code lives in the monitoring account, a keyholder whose availability is real rather than nominal, a building or facility entry procedure, or the household's written acceptance of forced entry — proven during the visit rather than assumed.

A fixed, code-opened box holding a door key so responders can enter without forcing the door. It is an entry mechanism with a real security trade-off, chosen by the household rather than by the installer, and its code is stored under the operator's data-handling rule in the monitoring account rather than on a note in the home.

The mandatory pre-go-live sequence that proves the whole chain at once: a press from a hard location, floor-level two-way voice, the operator's read-back of the live account record, distinct identification of each button, the off-premise leg for a mobile unit, and the test flagged and logged. A partially passed sequence is a failed test and is repeated in full after the fix.

The training standard for the wearer: the person independently presses from a hard location, speaks with the operator, cancels a test alert and states in their own words when they would press, including for anything they would call for help about. Training ends when the wearer demonstrates it, not when the installer has finished explaining.

The binary checkpoint at the end of an installation whose conditions are the outputs of everything upstream — assent, justified device class, verified dispatch record, verified contacts and entry, a passed end-to-end test, demonstrated teach-back and the caregiver briefing — each mapping to a named artifact. Failing it leaves the account not live with the open item, a notified household, a return date and an owner.

A periodic automatic check-in a monitored unit sends to the monitoring centre to say it is still present, powered and reachable; its absence past the platform's supervision window is what lets a centre report a unit missing rather than silently assume it is fine.

The interval the monitoring platform allows between supervisory signals before it treats a unit as missing. It is the ceiling under which the test cadence and health routine must be designed, and it is a property of the operator's own monitoring contract rather than a universal figure.

A deliberate end-to-end activation run on a schedule to prove that a press in the wearer's actual living space still reaches the centre, is identified to the right account and establishes voice where the equipment supports it; the recorded result is the account's own evidence that the service worked.

The single authoritative per-account record every routine, alarm and billing action reads from, carrying the wearer's names, the service address and access details, equipment serials and transport, the contact tree and the disclosure and authority lists — each field with a last-confirmed date and reconciled against the monitoring centre's copy.

Two separate recorded lists per account, dated to the wearer's own statement: who may be told what about the wearer, and who may change or end the service. Collapsing them is the origin of most family friction in this business, and a payer is never an authority by default.

Any event that sends an alarm signal to the monitoring centre, whether from a button press, a detection-class feature or an accident. Every activation leaves the account degraded in some way until it is deliberately restored, re-tested and its exposed access and contact facts corrected.

An activation that did not correspond to a need for help — a pendant pressed by a chair arm, handling during a care transfer, a dropped unit read as a fall — costly in responder goodwill and family trust, and dangerous mainly because the cheapest fix is to make the device less likely to fire at all.

The evidence-by-evidence rebuild of what happened along the whole chain — button and cell, radio path, transport, centre handling, contact tree, entry — performed inside the centre's record-retention window and completed before any cause is stated to a family, with anything unestablished recorded as undetermined.

A temporary hold on a live account, legitimate only when it genuinely serves the customer, such as a rehabilitation stay that may end with a return home. It becomes a retention device the moment it is offered to avoid recording a cancellation, so it always carries an end date and a named owner.

The recorded category of why an account ended — death of the wearer, move to higher care, hospitalisation, a cost decision, non-wear, a service failure, a competitor, or an account the wearer never wanted — used to route the ending to the right handling path and to make the book readable; some classes are never treated as opportunities to save.

The check that cancelling is no harder than joining, compared step by step, channel by channel and on elapsed time against the current sign-up path, including an explicit stop of the payment authorisation, a written confirmation and a stated equipment-return method. It is run before any change to the cancellation route is accepted.

The way the recurring book is read: what a live account contributes each month after the wholesale monitoring rate, processing and servicing; how long accounts persist; what the mix of ending reasons says about why they leave; and what service load costs — every term naming the internal document it traces to, with no industry figure asserted.

competency_questions_covered: What is this business actually selling when a frightened family asks whether the device will keep their mother safe, and which questions must be referred out instead of answered?
Which selling behaviours are hard stops when the buyer is eighty-six, hard of hearing, and alone in the house, and how are they enforced rather than merely intended?
How is the real risk of an unwitnessed fall described honestly without frightening a widow into buying, and which specific sentences are banned outright?
Before anyone repeats a claim about battery life, range, fall detection or how fast a call is answered, what evidence must exist for it?
Who is the wearer, who is the payer, who influences the decision, and whose agreement is genuinely required before an installation can be booked?
When do families actually buy a medical-alert system, and how does this business show up in those windows without exploiting a crisis?
Which professional referral sources exist in a local market, what may each of them legitimately do for this business, and what may this business give them in return?
How is the offer assembled from equipment, activation and monitoring, and what must the customer be told about total cost before being asked to decide anything?
What do the cancellation and refund terms say, and why does making exit easy strengthen rather than weaken the subscription book?
How does a monitoring account actually make money over its life, and how do we tell whether a given referral channel is paying for itself?
When should this business refuse the sale outright, and how is that refusal delivered, recorded and followed up?
How is this business compared with national advertised brands and with a smartwatch emergency button, in a way a family can trust?
What must be signed, disclosed, assented to and recorded before an installation appointment is allowed onto the schedule?
Which device class - an in-home base with a worn pendant, a mobile cellular unit with location, or both - fits this household, and what evidence from this home decides it?
How do I assess a home before I commit to a configuration, and which things must I measure rather than assume?
What may I honestly say about automatic fall detection, and what must I never claim?
What happens to this system when the power or the broadband goes down, and how do I verify that rather than repeat the brochure?
How is the monitoring-centre account built so a signal reaches the right address with instructions a dispatcher can act on?
Who goes on the emergency contact tree, in what order, and what must be true of each entry before it is saved?
How does a responder get into the home when the wearer is on the floor and cannot open the door?
What exactly does the mandatory end-to-end test consist of, and what result lets me leave the house with the account live?
How do I train an older adult so that they actually press the button, including after an embarrassing false alarm?
Where is the line between fitting equipment and giving medical advice when the family asks me care questions in the living room?
What do I do when the wearer does not want the device but the adult child has already paid for it?
How do I run the same protocol when the device is shipped and no technician ever enters the home?
What documentation must exist when the visit ends, and what is each part of it for?
Where do the base unit and the supplementary buttons physically go, and what makes a placement wrong?
What does the live monitoring subscription actually promise the wearer and the family, and what must never be promised during the service relationship?
What is recorded on a live account, and how do we know that record is still true this month rather than true at installation?
Who may be told what about the wearer, and who may change or end the account when the person paying is not the person wearing it?
How is the periodic test-signal programme designed, and what happens when a scheduled test is missed?
How do we know a device is healthy — battery, supervision, connectivity, consumables — without repeating a manufacturer's claim?
The pendant is in a drawer — how do we detect that, and how do we raise it without shaming the wearer or overriding her?
A real activation happened last night — what does the business do in the hours and days afterwards?
A family says they pressed the button and no help came — how is that investigated, and what is said to them?
The same account keeps producing accidental activations — how is that reduced without weakening the protection the family pays for?
The wearer is moving to assisted living, is in hospital, or has died — what happens to the account, the billing and the equipment?
How does a customer actually cancel, and how do we prove the exit is no harder than the entry?
How do we read whether the recurring book is healthy without inventing an industry figure?
When may we ask a well-served family or a professional caregiver for a referral, and when must we never ask?
A carrier generation or the monitoring platform is being retired and part of the fleet will stop signalling — what do we do?
